license_note: No LICENSE file ships in the weight repository; the gated card links the Mistral Research License as the governing terms. The MRL grants use, copying, modification, and distribution but limits all use of the model, derivatives, and outputs to non-profit, non-commercial research purposes, with commercial use requiring a separate license from Mistral AI, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 weights and derivatives, linked from the gated model card

access_boundary: This record represents the October 2024 Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 weight release at Hugging Face commit 2f494a194c5b980dfb9772cb92d26cbb671fce5a (last modified 2025-07-31). Its ministral-8b-2410 API line retired on December 31, 2025 with migration directed at Ministral 3 8B. The Ministral 3B sibling, later Ministral lines, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Gated 8B edge checkpoint under explicit research-only terms, runnable on 24 GB single-GPU setups
Release, retirement, and replacement all dated across first-party card, news, and docs
tradeoffs: Research-only grant forces any commercial use onto a separate Mistral commercial license
The managed API is retired, leaving gated self-operation as the supported path

evidence.label: Official model card and gated weight release
